description: CLAUDE.md states 'Canonical serialization: RFC 8785 canonical JSON + Corundum Chapter 31 conventions'. The actual implementation in canonical.rs produces a custom line-oriented text format (CRLF header lines followed by a NUL+LF separator and raw body bytes), not RFC 8785 JSON at all. Test vectors in tests/vectors.rs confirm the custom format. This is a documentation/spec mismatch that can mislead maintainers writing new serialization consumers or external integration code.
title: core: CLAUDE.md claims RFC 8785 canonical JSON; code uses custom text format
